capabilities: Copy documents from the BYOK device into vault folders as notes
Detect the mounted device volume automatically or via a mount path override
Merge changes between device documents and vault notes, saving conflicts as dated copies
Convert leading spaces to match the editor's indentation settings
Choose which projects to sync and whether to save as Markdown or plain text
disambiguation: Unrelated to Obsidian's Sync service; it copies files one-way from a USB writing device into the vault.
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux); uses Node.js file system APIs unavailable on mobile. Reads files outside the vault to find the device and makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no way to pull documents off a BYOK writing device when it is mounted as a USB disk.
summary: One-way syncer that copies documents from a Bring Your Own Keyboard (BYOK) writing device, connected over USB, into vault folders as notes.
